questions: Is the fare the same in both directions (Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle), or should each direction be its own route with its own fare?
Who should be allowed to add routes and change fares? Should that need a password, while passengers can only look up fares?
If a passenger asks about two stops with no direct route between them, what should happen: just say there is no route, or work out a trip that changes trotros and add up the fares?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
